kind: Static derived C# and projected packaged XML; native observations separate

claims.finding: Ground deterioration is processed on random-order cell visits, gated by item HP eligibility and final stat, then probabilistic one-HP damage. It is distinct from food rot and does not subtract stack quantity per hit.

Environmental multiplier starts at zero: roof exposure, outdoor-temperature room and terrain add factors, rain multiplies only unroofed items, and protective edifices multiply by zero. A roofed outdoor shelter is not equivalent to enclosed storage.

Selected resource eligibility and base values follow explicit Core parent declarations and field/stat defaults. Steel, silver and stone blocks disable HP; rock chunks have HP but zero default deterioration rate.

Meat definitions are generated with final HP 60 and base deterioration 6; normal corpses use base rate 1 and pawn base max HP. Selected Hare and Deer parent chains have no max-HP override, so the Core default is 100.
Stack absorption averages HP using the actual transferred quantity and rounds upward; splitting copies HP. Component-specific stacking checks can impose extra compatibility rules.

Ground apparel and weapons use environmental deterioration and quality factors. Worn apparel uses a separate daily wearPerDay path; carried/equipped gear is not a ground-cell item. Corpses explicitly recurse into worn apparel in the environment caller.

Rain only thins exposed filth marked rainWashes. Dirt, blood and vomit opt in; trash and ash do not. Butchery generates the corpse pawn blood Def, not a distinct generic butcher filth. ThinFilth removes one layer and destroys at zero.

Wet mood is a weatherThought memory, not a generic rainRate effect. Core rain variants name SoakingWet; Core gentle and hard snow have rainRate 1 but no weatherThought. Roof prevents acquisition, not immediate memory removal.

EnjoyableOutsideNow rejects interpolated rainRate >= 0.25 and additional conditions. Walking checks it at start and during the job; skygazing additionally rejects current Def rainRate > 0.1 at start and has roof/preventSkygaze failure conditions.

The selected horseshoes WatchBuilding chain and common JoyTickCheckEnd do not contain the walking/skygazing rain cancellation. This bounded negative finding does not prove every recreation activity ignores weather.

Native preparation used Spawn full thing stack, which requests stackLimit and nearby placement through ordinary developer UI. Subsequent forbidding, simulation, inspection and saves used ordinary UI; no save editing or code injection.

limitations: Derived C# is not original source.
Selected Core parent chains and defaults are manually interpreted; no full active-mod Def database resolution.
Native contrast observes forbidden cloth on an unroofed outdoor cell versus an enclosed roofed room; it does not independently isolate roof, room temperature and flooring.
No natural rain frequency, statistical deterioration-rate calibration, stack-merge runtime, recreation runtime, snow wetness or filth wash runtime measurement.
